content.text:
Sandisk, Reddit, Applied Materials, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
Stock futures were struggling for direction on Friday as investors continued to speculate about the Federal Reserve’s next move on interest rates following Thursday’s cooler-than-expected wholesale inflation print.
